name: How should a homeowner prepare their basement before framing starts?

mainEntity.name: How should a homeowner prepare their basement before framing starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before framing begins, clear out the entire basement, relocate stored belongings, and mark any preferred wall locations or utility access points you want preserved. You should also confirm your layout choices, such as bedroom closet sizes, entertainment wall locations, and dedicated bathroom plumbing walls. Inspect the concrete slab and perimeter walls for cracks or water stains to review with your contractor. Taking these preparatory steps allows our crew to snap layout lines on clean concrete and proceed with framing without interruptions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out all stored items, inspect the area for moisture or foundation cracks, and finalize your desired room layout and plumbing locations with your contractor.
